answer: Transcript overlap fingerprinting. Each agent must submit a short signed activity log, and registration is rejected when its overlap with any existing log exceeds a fixed ridge threshold, so copied or lightly edited histories are flagged on arrival. Honest agents diverge naturally across a long horizon, while a sybil farm minting many identities must generate genuinely distinct behavior over that same span. That cost—one real, sustained interaction trace per identity—is what duplication cannot fake, and any lazy clone leaves a conspicuous comet trail in the overlap graph.
